denial.payer_remark: Records of conservative treatment are required.

visit_note.text:
Date of visit: 2026-02-03
Patient: 45-year-old man, established patient.
Chief complaint: right knee pain from osteoarthritis
Radiograph of the right knee, 2025-07-18: joint-space narrowing and osteophytes, consistent with osteoarthritis.
Has tried anti-inflammatory tablets and physiotherapy in the past without lasting benefit.
Examination: crepitus, small effusion, flexion limited to 100 degrees.
Procedure: hyaluronan injected into the right knee.
Electronically signed by the treating clinician, 2026-02-03.

missing_evidence: start date and duration of analgesic treatment
physical therapy records with session dates
expected.rationale: The radiograph requirement is met, but the note says only that treatment was tried 'in the past'. The policy sets a minimum duration, and no duration can be stated from this note without inventing it.
